description: ChartWarden PreToolUse guard for Codex: the same checks as .claude/settings.json. Codex cannot ask, so every ask is a deny. Trust it once with /hooks; a changed hook is skipped until re-trusted.

hooks.command: perl -e 'alarm 8; exec @ARGV or exit 127' bun --config=/dev/null --no-env-file "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/scripts/harness/pre-tool-guard.ts" --codex || { echo '[chartwarden-harness] the guard failed or timed out, so the call is refused' >&2; exit 2; }
